newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian premier to visit China on June 26-28.
newsitem.headline: Russian premier to visit China on June 26-28.

text.p: Russian Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin will visit China on June 26-28, the Kremlin spokesman said on Thursday.
Sergei Yastrzhembsky told a news briefing that President Boris Yeltsin had authorised the visit but he gave no other details.
Russia and China, keen to promote political and economic ties, have decided that the prime ministers of the two countries should have regular meetings.
Chinese President Jiang Zemin visited Russia in April.
